title: uu was removed in Python 3.13: use binascii.b2a_uu

problem.description: uu is gone in 3.13 (PEP 594). binascii implements the same line encoding.

files.check.py:
import binascii
from uuenc import encode

data = bytes(range(256)) * 2
out = encode(data, 'blob.bin')
lines = out.split(b'\n')
assert lines[0] == b'begin 644 blob.bin', lines[0]
assert out.endswith(b'end\n')
body = [l for l in lines[1:] if l not in (b'', b' ', b'end')]
assert b''.join(binascii.a2b_uu(l) for l in body) == data

limitations.proves: Output round-trips byte-exact and keeps the begin/end framing.
